handoffNotes: Phase 10U completed local real write approval boundary, checklist, and handoff.
Approval boundary ready means future authorization request eligibility only; it is not actual registry write authorization.
No registry write, no registry mutation, no publish, no current User App Shell package replacement, no production writer creation.
Future actual write still requires separate explicit owner authorization in Phase 10V or later.
